golden_apples.title: The Golden Apples
golden_apples.text: Every night someone steals the golden apples from the emperor's garden. The youngest prince will keep watch, if your armies prove the realm is worth it.

stolen_lights.title: The Stolen Sun and Moon
stolen_lights.text: The zmei have stolen the sun and the moon. Take back two of their provinces, and Greuceanu will forge his mace and ride.

hoard_of_hoards.title: The Hoard of Hoards
hoard_of_hoards.text: The griffin-hag will only guard a hoard worth guarding. Gather nine hundred gold in your treasury.

a_princess.title: A Princess for the Dragon
a_princess.text: No zmeu is respected without a stolen princess. Carry off a rival's heir, and Spânul will serve you.

the_fairest.title: The Fairest of All
the_fairest.text: Ileana Cosânzeana will walk only in a great realm. Hold ten provinces.

sacred_woods.title: The Sacred Woods
sacred_woods.text: The Queen of the Fairies sleeps in the old forests. Hold four forest provinces to wake her.

witch_due.title: The Witch's Due
witch_due.text: Baba Cloanța asks for a kingdom worth haunting, from the marshes to the hills. Rule twelve provinces.

full_moon.title: Under the Full Moon
full_moon.text: The werewolf lord follows only a winning pack. Win twelve battles.
